verdict.rationale: Ledgy's marketing pages say equity grants, documents and signature workflows can be handled in bulk, with share awards created, signed and shared "in bulk" in a few clicks. That is a real first-party bulk capability. However, it appears limited to the granting workflow, and the documented GraphQL API exposes only read operations (auth, companyCaptable, companyTransactions with paging), so there is no evidenced programmatic bulk mutation for AI-native automation. Missing for 10: bulk operations beyond grants/documents/signatures, API-level bulk write endpoints, in-depth docs on bulk limits and behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Automate your granting, document and signature workflows in bulk to make expansion easy.
